fact_identity: instrument economic tuple incl native_epoch + explicit aligned timeframe/window; normalized exact decimal OHLCV content; proof/locator/source-asof/receipt differences not new economic windows
fact_revisions: same window with different numeric OHLCV censored across all roles, no latest/winner selection
numeric_policy: bounded non-exponent decimal lexemes canonicalized exactly; prices>0,volume>=0,exact decimal OHLC geometry; preserve original row proof pointers
temporal_policy: end<=source_ts<=body_completed_ts<=available_at<=decision_ts; unknown body completion is ineligible, never use header in its place
attempt_policy: group full declared attempts by cohort/upstream/attempt_id; identical replays count once; distinct variants censor one whole attempt; order-independent counters
acquisition_policy: separate cost-first cohort/upstream/acquisition_id ledger across roles/consumers; same MEASURED count/UNKNOWN/NOT_ATTEMPTED claim collapses even with different proof locators; inconsistent claims or UNKNOWN censor total/ratio; invalid/FACT-ineligible attempts cannot erase valid cost receipts
cost_unknown: known measured HTTP lower bound only, total and facts-per-HTTP NULL whenever any unknown/conflict/unbound cost receipt; no native budget or admission
legacy: existing sourceUtility and all current canonical modules unchanged; legacy comparison only in ONE UNEXECUTED connected callable
